title: Add the second call
starter:
%x = param [] slot=0 dtype=i32 addrspace=ALU
%y = param [] slot=1 dtype=i32 addrspace=ALU
%p = param [] slot=0 dtype=i32 addrspace=ALU
%a = add %p 1
%f = mul %a %a
%r1 = call %f %x
%out = add %r1 %r1
hints: The first call is `%r1 = call %f %x`. The second one looks the same, with a new name and a different value handed in.
Add `%r2 = call %f %y` above the last line. The body `%f` is not written again.
The last line should add the two results: `%out = add %r1 %r2`.

answer.code:
%x = param [] slot=0 dtype=i32 addrspace=ALU
%y = param [] slot=1 dtype=i32 addrspace=ALU
%p = param [] slot=0 dtype=i32 addrspace=ALU
%a = add %p 1
%f = mul %a %a
%r1 = call %f %x
%r2 = call %f %y
%out = add %r1 %r2
answer.explain: The body `%f` is written once. `call %f %x` fills its hole with x and `call %f %y` fills the same hole with y, so the two calls give `(x + 1) * (x + 1)` and `(y + 1) * (y + 1)`. The last line adds them.
